leaves.title: Freeze 100 approved single-subject seeds and fixed manifestation
leaves.acceptance: 100 unique approved Atlas seeds; RASTER/ISOLATED_OBJECT/ISOLATED_CARTOON_WATERCOLOR/L0 frozen; no canary-extra seeds.

leaves.title: Transition ten provider@cluster routes to PRODUCTION_READY through live master proof
leaves.acceptance: Each of 10 provider@cluster routes demonstrates accepted live master proof and fresh readiness evidence; route certification is distinct from throughput allocation.

leaves.title: Run alternating cluster slots with dynamic healthy-capacity allocation until 100 unique accepted masters
leaves.acceptance: Cluster A/B retain one-generation-per-cluster safety and sequential provider attempts. After all ten routes are certified, providers are not capped at ten successes; healthy available routes absorb capacity from quota-limited/cooldown routes. Global target is exactly 100 accepted unique masters and no slot may overshoot it.

leaves.title: Evaluate 100-master QA distinctness distribution and economics
leaves.acceptance: Exactly 100 unique successful masters, all 10 provider@cluster routes certified, QA/distinctness pass, package-capacity truth bound to FA-123, economics/storage reported without volume inflation. Equal 10-per-route distribution is not a production throughput requirement.
